page.overview:
Who is Knuckle Buster?

Knuckle Buster is one of the minor antagonists in Invincible. She, along with her husband Force Fist, were an extremist group planning to cause mass-murder and subsequently change society. The both of them were enemies of Cecil Stedman.

Knuckle Buster was a tall and curvaceous light skinned woman with long blonde hair reaching down to her lower back, thick eyebrows, and large lips. While operating as an extremist she wore a dark blue leotard which exposed her legs, with elbow length sleeves and white fur trim around her V-line which reached down to her waist. She also wore a red mask that covered her scalp, with an opening for her hair, a pair of fingerless red gloves and matching red sneaker shoes. Finishing up her costume were black knee pads, a black strap around her right hip and a red sash with the emblem of The Order of the Freeing Fist, a winged skull, as a belt-buckle.

While operating as a store clerk she dressed in an orange Indian dress, dark red pants underneath, a red cloth going around her left shoulder and right hip, a red head cloth and a pair of light-colored sneakers.

Knuckle Buster was a fanatical humanist extremist who opposed industrial life. This is shown in her overemphasis on human strength and spirit instead of using weapons such as firearms. Both her and her husband proved to be delusional, believing that through mass murder and chaos humanity would relinquish modern society for a more optimal way of life. To that end, her and Force Fist attempted to release a flesh killing bioweapon upon a city, in hopes that others would learn from their example. As the gas began to peel away at their skin, Knuckle Buster and Force Fist did not seem to mind the pain, but rather accepted it, highlighting their resolve.
